task: Implement the P5 BYOK core on top of completion/advanced-arena at HEAD ff4ace5. Add an app-owned provider module and Tauri bridge/commands for OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini configuration and execution boundaries. Credentials must be stored/retrieved through OS-protected credential storage (Windows Credential Manager/DPAPI or an equivalent OS-native backend; on unsupported platforms fail closed rather than writing plaintext). Never return or log secret values; list/read operations expose only redacted metadata. Add bounded provider endpoint/model validation, explicit external-network consent/notice, request timeouts and response-size limits, provider-specific request/response normalization, and tests using local/mock transports only (no real provider calls). Add cost estimation from dated price snapshots, actual usage/cost when a response reports usage, confirmation thresholds, hard budget ceilings, and fail-closed handling for missing/invalid prices or usage. Preserve the local Ollama runtime and existing run persistence; do not weaken sandboxing or expose secrets in run records/exports. Add a usable Settings BYOK panel wired to the bridge with configure/remove/test controls, secure-storage state, network warning, cost policy controls, and clear unavailable/error states. Do not implement P6 dashboard polish, P7 packaging, or page-transition motion.
